'''Nuuswan''' was a [[Bird/Legends|bird]] that collected [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] in the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species']] mythology. "Nuuswan" was also a given name for Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|females]].<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nuuswan was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
